_doc: Story laws — machine copy of ROCK-RICH-BINDER/26-THE-STORY-LAWS.md. Story laws OUTRANK craft laws (montage-rules.json) at every level of the loop hierarchy. Positions are fractions of total runtime; runtime is an OUTPUT of the beat sheet (15-35 min legal).

sentence.template: Today {subject} set out to {goal}, and the environment {verb}ed him.
sentence.provenance: Gold Rush story producer, direct to Jason
sentence.test: the finished cut must be able to fill its own blanks; antagonist is the WORLD and must be established before it carries force

lesson.template: After watching this, I now know how/that I can {payoff}.
lesson.test: payoff must transfer to the viewer's own journey — technique, number, or principle; biography about the subject alone = FAIL
lesson.provenance: channel outlier data: all breakouts are you-framed payoffs

vehicle.rule_a: no lesson ships without a vehicle (unwrapped teaching = lecture, flag)
vehicle.rule_b: no big spectacle ships empty (payload-free wildness = candy; legal in fun_and_games, rationed elsewhere)

beats.test: thesis planted by someone OTHER than the hero, not yet believed
world+flaw+stakes; every later payoff planted; save-the-cat moment present
doubt posing a question; strictly AFTER catalyst
the hero's ACTIVE choice into the new world
new thread carrying the THEME (doc: the relationship under the task)
the promise of the premise SHOWN, escalating; min ~20% of runtime
FALSE victory or FALSE defeat; stakes raise; clock starts
compounding setbacks, external AND internal (the flaw re-presses)
lowest point, OPPOSITE polarity to midpoint, with a whiff of death (a concrete on-screen loss)
reflective sit IN the loss; distinct from the loss event itself
the answer via A+B fusion; theme pays off
the CHANGED hero executes through escalation; no un-set-up devices

cross_rules.rule: a cold open is neither opening_image nor catalyst; its material may not be re-staged as-if-new before p=0.15
anything carrying story force must be planted in setup before it is used
beats appear in canonical order; catalyst -> debate -> break_into_two strict
beats 1 and 15 share a visual register and differ in state
beat 2's line pays off in beats 13-15
b_story intro < midpoint; A/B cross at midpoint; fusion at break_into_three
midpoint and all_is_lost carry opposite emotional polarity
all_is_lost (event) and dark_night (reflection) are distinct; collapsed = double-beat flag
any point beat >5% of runtime off its window is flagged
one improbable premise per episode (double mumbo jumbo)

cliffhanger.rule: a serialized episode may end at all_is_lost/dark_night; beats 13-15 roll into the next episode's open; final_image becomes a DARK MIRROR (same register, polarity reversed, resolution owed)
cliffhanger.example: EP1 ends locked in the dump; EP2 opens on the rescue (blessed ruling)

episodic_variants.season_nesting: each episode's Sentence is a clause of the season's Sentence; episode lessons accumulate toward the season thesis; per-episode open loops are season pipe

steps: state the Sentence from the transcript alone
state the Lesson in viewer first person
does what is said, in this order, make sense with no pictures
sense_pass.rule: a comp failing any step returns to the bench

retention.calibration_source: MirrΩr curves of Jason's own best videos, not industry folklore

runtime.rule: runtime is an OUTPUT of the beat sheet; critics prevent padding (montage law 1: length is redundancy)
